=== March 2014 ===
* [[Ben]] started working on the [[SolSeed History]] page to help share the story of our first ten years with members and friends.

=== February 2014 ===
* [[Brandon]] attended the big Pagan convention, [[Pantheacon 2015]] in San Jose on President's Day Weekend.
* [[Ben]] visited the world-famous [[Biosphere 2]] closed-ecosystem research facility near Tucson on Friday the 20th.
* On Saturday the 28th, [[Brandon]], [[Shelley]], [[Sequoia]], [[Ren]], [[Ben]] and his parents held the [[SolSeed 10th Anniversary Celebration]], featuring a canoe trip to Ross Island in Portland.

=== December 2014 ===
* [[Brandon]] started the [http://gaia.wiki Gaia Wiki] project, and [[Ben]] and [[Eric]] helped create content for it.
* On Saturday the 21st, [[Brandon]], [[Shelley]], [[Sequoia]], [[Ren]], [[Ben]] and his parents, and [[Ted]] and his family participated in the [[Longest Night Masquerade]], featuring a blend of SolSeed and Pagan elements such as the "Holly King and Queen."

=== November 2014 ===
* [[Brandon]] got his [http://humanisticpaganism.com/2014/11/16/gaias-heartbeat-practicing-empathy-for-the-mother-of-us-all-by-brandon-sanders/ blog entry] about [[Gaia's Heartbeat]] posted on the Humanistic Paganism website.

=== October 2014 ===
* On Sunday the 5th, [[Eric]] presented a [[Unitarian Universalist Fellowship of Ottawa Service Entitled, "SolSeed: An Example of Defining a Life Purpose"|service about SolSeed]] for the Unitarian Universalist Fellowship of Ottawa.
* SolSeed became a partner of the [http://spiritualnaturalistsociety.org The Spiritual Naturalist Society]

=== September 2014 ===
* On Saturday the 20th, [[Ben]] gave a talk at the [[Seed Village]] about global warming and ways to fix it, attended by [[Brandon]], [[Shelley]], [[Sequoia]], [[Ren]], Ben's parents, and three new acquaintances. Then we made protest signs which we brought to the [http://act.350.org/event/peoples_climate/7762 climate rally] the next day.
* On Friday the 26th, [[Eric]] got his blog post [http://humanisticpaganism.com/2014/09/26/why-im-religious-but-not-spiritual-by-eric-saumur/ Why I'm Religious but not Spiritual] posted on the Humanistic Paganism website.

=== August 2014 ===
* [[Ben]] traveled with Lion, a long-time [[friend]] of SolSeed, to visit the [http://www.windward.org/2.0/index.php Windward] intentional community in southern Washington State.

=== July 2014 ===
* [[Ben]] finished a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5BGDLdHfn3E short music video] using the chorus of [[The Seed]].

=== June 2014 ===
* [[Brandon]], [[Shelley]], [[Sequoia]], [[Ren]], [[Ben]], [[Eric]], and [[Patrick]] got together on Mt. Hood in Oregon for [[Sol 2014]].

=== March 2014 ===
* In Portland, [[Brandon]], [[Shelley]], [[Sequoia]], [[Ren]], and [[Ben]] celebrated the Spring Equinox by planting bioswales in the Lents neighborhood, then joined [[Eric]] via Skype to [http://www.meetup.com/SolSeed/events/170344262/ tell stories about life in the Phanerozoic Eon].
* The SolSeed Movement began an experiment with a system of governance called [http://holacracy.org/ Holacracy].

=== February 2014 ===
* [[Eric]] created our [http://us2.campaign-archive2.com/?u=13bb3beac4bdd8a84e81f0a49&id=aeb104e4d0&e= second orientation email].

=== January 2014 ===
* [[Brandon]] created the [http://us2.campaign-archive2.com/?u=13bb3beac4bdd8a84e81f0a49&id=68156dd609&e= first SolSeed orientation email]. 
* John completed the [[Gaia's Heartbeat]] music video, working through several drafts and incorporating our feedback.

=== December 2014 ===
* John completed the [[Gaia's Heartbeat]] song and started work on the accompanying video.
* For the Winter Solstice, we invited two teachers from a company called [http://musictogether-pdx.com/ Music Together] to lead us in a series of sing-alongs, including dancing and instruments such as drums and “jingle bells” that everyone could play. 
* We returned to the first liturgical season, [[Genesis]], which uses the original opening ritual developed back in 2010.

=== November 2013 ===
* We started celebrating the eighth liturgical season, [[Viventibus Galaxia]] (Living Galaxies).
* [[Brandon]] started working with John Boswell on a new song and music video called [[Gaia's Heartbeat]].

=== September 2013 ===
* On the Fall Equinox, [[Brandon]], [[Shelley]], [[Sequoia]], [[Ren]], and [[Ben]] went on a hike and had a picnic dinner at Bridal Veil Falls in the Columbia Gorge.
* Eric's family had an equinox dinner where each food item combined dark and light colors to represent the balance of day and night on the Equinox.
* We established a SolSeed "liturgical year" that will have eight separate rituals for our [[Weekly Service Calls]], and started using the new ritual for [[Viventibus Mundos]] (Living Worlds), the seventh of the eight "liturgical seasons."

=== June 2013 ===
* We held the [[Sol 2013]] retreat in Ottawa.
* We sponsored a Portland State Aerospace Society [http://psas.pdx.edu/launch10/#index5h2 rocket launch]!

=== May 2013 ===
* John and Will completed the final draft of the [[SolSeedSong]]!

=== April 2013 ===
* John and Will completed the first draft of the [[SolSeedSong]].

=== March 2013 ===
* We held the [[2013 Spring Equinox Storytelling and Suishi Feast‎]] in Portland and Ottawa.

=== January 2013 ===
* We held the [[2013 Vision/Purpose Retreat]] on Skype to talk about what SolSeed is all about and what our primary statement of purpose should look like (or if we should have more than one!)

=== December 2012 ===
* We held rocket launching events for the Winter Solstice, one in [[2012 Portland Winter Solstice Event|Portland]] and one in [http://www.meetup.com/SolSeed-Ottawa/events/91063842/ Ottawa].
[[File:RocketToTheDestinySupplies.png|200px]]

=== November 2012 ===
* [[Ben]] finished the [[SolSeedSong]] lyrics and sent them to John and Will.
* [[Brandon]] got partial a hard copy of the [[SolSeed book]] printed so we could see what it would look like.

=== October 2012 ===
* First [http://www.meetup.com/SolSeed-Ottawa/events/84842872/ Seeing Nature - Reading & Practice] in Ottawa

=== September 2012 ===
* We built tabletop biospheres on the [http://www.meetup.com/SolSeed/events/82010942/ Fall Equinox]. Unfortunately they didn't last very long.
* [[Eric]] held an [http://www.meetup.com/SolSeed-Ottawa/events/72836712/ Equinox in Space] celebration in Ottawa.
* Completed the [[Tree Waterer Sub Movement|pedal powered water pump]]

=== August 2012 ===
* We helped fund John Boswell and Will Crowley's original album of songs about science, [http://terralumina.bandcamp.com/album/terra-lumina Terra Lumina]. In exchange, they're writing  the [[SolSeedSong]] !
* [[Ben]] presented a paper called "Why go to space?" at the [[2012 Space Elevator Conference]].
* Started weekly "[http://www.amazon.com/Seeing-Nature-Deliberate-Encounters-Visible/dp/189013242X Seeing Nature]" [http://www.meetup.com/SolSeed/events/77421192/ reading and practice meetup events] in Portland

=== July 2012 ===
*The beginning of the [[Tree_Waterer_Sub_Movement|pedal powered water pump]]

=== June 2012 ===
* [[Ben]] is presenting a [[PeoplePowerTalk|talk]] at the [http://fremontartscouncil.org/fremont-solstice-parade/we-the-people-power-festival/ We the People Power Festival] on the 16th in Seattle.
* We're holding our fifth big unconference retreat, [[Sol 2012]], starting on the Summer Solstice at the the Oregon coast.
* We're also holding our first ever Summer Solstice triathlon in Portland, [[YayLifeTri]], along with [[Eric]]'s companion event in [http://www.meetup.com/SolSeed-Ottawa/events/65147032/ Ottawa].

=== April 2012 ===
* We visited the Silverton area for [[Earth Day 2012]].

=== March 2012 ===
* We had an awesome [[Spring Equinox 2012|Spring Equinox Festival]] at the [[Seed Village]] in Portland, Oregon, featuring lots of activities for kids, music and dancing, and brunch.
* We also [[Spring Equinox 2012 - March 19, 2012 Story Tell and Sushi Feast|told stories and shared sushi]] in Ottawa, Ontario, home to new active member [[Eric]] and his family.
* [[Ben]] met some famous scientists and had a great time helping to design an alien culture at the [[Contact Conference]] in Sunnyvale, California.

=== January 2012 ===
* The first SolSeed Meetups involve a sit-down dinner and then a [http://www.symphonyofscience.com Symphony of Science] movie-watching party.

=== December 2011 ===
* We held our third [[Winter Solstice 2011|Winter Solstice celebration]], featuring a hike up Mt. Taber in the dark, followed by a candlelit dinner.

=== October 2011 ===
* We created the [http://www.meetup.com/SolSeed SolSeed Meetup group] and quickly got several interesting people signed up.
* We started cultivating kindred [[Topical Communities]].

=== September 2011 ===
* For the Fall Equinox this year, we're participating in the [http://www.moving-planet.org Moving Planet] worldwide climate action event by holding a [http://www.moving-planet.org/events/us/portland/1142 group bike ride] to the [http://www.moving-planet.org/events/us/portland/527 big Portland event].
* [[Brandon]], [[Shelley]], [[Sequoia]], [[Ben]], and [[Boni]] are all going to Orlando, Florida for the [http://www.100yss.org/ 100 Year Starship Symposium]!

=== August 2011 ===
* [[Ben]] and [[Brandon]] attended the [http://spacewiki.com/Space_Elevator_Conference Space Elevator Conference] in Redmond to promote [[SpaceWiki]], and Brandon gave a talk about building a [http://www.startram.com railway to space] for the 150th aniversary of the transcontinental railroad.

=== June 2011 ===
* To celebrate the Summer Solstice this year, we went on a [[Summer Solstice 2011|hike to beautiful Wahclella Falls]] in the Columbia Gorge, followed by dinner at the Seed Village.

=== May 2011 ===
* On Memorial Day weekend, we held a [[Vision Workshop]] at the [[Seed Village]].

=== April 2011 ===
* We once again attended the City Repair [[Earth Day 2011|Earth Day festival]] as exhibitors, this time with a triple-wide booth where we also hosted Mathew and Molly with [http://www.cloacina.org Cloacina] and Gus with the [http://www.greengranges.org/ Green Granges].

=== March 2011 ===
* We hired [http://www.swiftarch.com Swift Architecture] to start designing the "Seed Pod," the backyard cottage that will be the second home added to the [[Seed Village]].

=== February 2011 ===
* We held our fourth [[Open Space]] event, [[Seed 2011]], on the slopes of Mt. Hood!

=== January 2011 ===
* We had a [[Music Festival]] on the 15th featuring local singer, songwriter, and pianist [http://www.reverbnation.com/lorihenriques Lori Henriques]!

=== October 2010 ===
* Molly took us on an [[EcoVillageTour]], visiting five intentional communities around East Portland.
* [[Brandon]] quit his job at [http://www.aboutus.org AboutUs] and founded the first [[SolSeedBusiness]], quickly obtaining contracts to do [[consensus polling]] for the [http://www.mmt.org Meyer Memorial Trust] and a follow on contract with AboutUs continuing work he was doing before he left.

=== September 2010 ===
* We held a [[SolSeed Service]] celebrating the [[EquinoxCelebration|Fall Equinox]] at the [[SolSeedVillage]].

=== August 2010 ===
* [[SolSeed]] helped sponsor the [http://www.buckmanpdx.org/picnic Buckman Neighborhood Picnic] and held another [[SecondMural|mural painting]] there.

=== July 2010 ===
* [[Brandon]] and [[Ben]] went to the [[NewSpace 2010]] conference in Sunnyvale, CA to promote the new [[SpaceWiki]] project.

=== June 2010 ===
* We officially decided that [[Brandon]] and [[Shelley]]'s house ''is'' the site for the [[SolSeedVillage]]!
* Then we held a [[Longest Day Party]] in their backyard on the Summer Solstice.

=== May 2010 ===
* [["Lettuce" Bring Life]] -- the seeds planted at our [[Earth Day 2010]] event are germinating! [[Image:100505 Wed 1349 45.jpg|100px|thumb|right|Milky Way Lettuce Day 11]]

=== April 2010 ===

* We had a double-wide booth at the Portland Earth Day event, [http://cityrepair.org/projects/earthday/ "Re-Seeding Our World"], with fun activities including actual seed planting!

=== March 2010 ===

* We held the second [[SolSeed Service]], featuring an equinox-themed celebration and discussion of [[Balance]], including a fun children's activity and followed by a potluck.

=== February 2010 ===
